header: Limits and formats the extraction API accepts
description: These figures are for the hosted service on the Scale plan. Edge appliances run the same models; their throughput depends on your hardware, not on a request limit.

specs.label: Input formats
specs.value: PDF, TIFF, PNG, JPEG and DOCX

specs.label: Maximum request
specs.value: 80 MB, up to 300 pages per call

specs.label: Median response
specs.value: 1.4 s per page, 3.1 s at the 95th percentile
